data_gate.policy: If the Coin Metrics Community endpoint does not return both assets with required 2020-2024 daily coverage without authentication, classify DATA_BLOCKED and STOP. Do not fall back to a provider endpoint that exposes 2025/2026.

execution.entry: Monday 00:00 UTC BTCUSDT directional entry after >=48h lag from Saturday cutoff

mve0_pass: Discovery top-minus-bottom spread > 0 after 10 bps RT
result not dominated by one year/event
at least 3 of 4 discovery years have non-negative spread
20 bps stress does not turn strongly negative
mve1_pass: Frozen 2025 holdout top-minus-bottom spread > 0 after 10 bps
objective: Test whether stablecoin capital expansion/contraction contains forward information for BTC weekly returns independent of OHLC transformations.
